items.title: Security update available for Adobe Commerce and Magento Open Source
items.summary: This bulletin resolves critical, important, and moderate vulnerabilities, including an unauthenticated customer account takeover (CVE-2026-71362) and multiple high-severity cross-site scripting and incorrect authorization flaws. Successful exploitation could lead to arbitrary code execution, security feature bypass, and privilege escalation.

items.title: Incorrect Authorization Vulnerability (Unauthenticated Customer Account Takeover)
items.summary: A critical incorrect authorization vulnerability in Adobe Commerce allows an unauthenticated remote attacker to switch a customer session to another customer account and escalate privileges without requiring administrator access. Indications suggest active exploitation in the wild.

items.title: Security update available for Adobe Commerce and Magento Open Source
items.summary: This security update addresses critical, important, and moderate vulnerabilities in Adobe Commerce and Magento Open Source. Successful exploitation could lead to arbitrary code execution, privilege escalation, and security feature bypass.

items.title: Security update available for Adobe Commerce and Magento Open Source
items.summary: Adobe released a security update for Adobe Commerce and Magento Open Source that resolves critical vulnerabilities. Successful exploitation of these issues could lead to arbitrary code execution.

items.title: Stored Cross-Site Scripting (XSS) Vulnerability
items.summary: A high-severity stored cross-site scripting vulnerability in Adobe Commerce could result in arbitrary code execution. Exploitation requires authentication but not administrator privileges.

items.title: Stored Cross-Site Scripting (XSS) Vulnerability
items.summary: This high-severity stored cross-site scripting vulnerability in Adobe Commerce could lead to arbitrary code execution. Exploitation requires both authentication and administrator privileges.

items.title: Incorrect Authorization Vulnerability (Security Feature Bypass)
items.summary: An incorrect authorization vulnerability affecting Adobe Commerce B2B could enable a security-feature bypass. Exploitation requires authentication but not administrator privileges.

items.title: Incorrect Authorization Vulnerability (Security Feature Bypass)
items.summary: This incorrect authorization vulnerability could enable a security-feature bypass in Adobe Commerce. It requires neither authentication nor administrator privileges for exploitation.

items.title: Critical Vulnerabilities in Amasty Magento Extensions
items.summary: Amasty issued a massive security release for dozens of extensions, including two critical vulnerabilities that can lead to remote code execution. Sansec Shield already blocks these critical issues.

items.title: Unauthenticated Arbitrary File Upload in Amasty Order Attributes
items.summary: A critical unauthenticated arbitrary file upload flaw in Amasty Order Attributes allows attackers to write executable files to a Magento store without logging in, potentially leading to remote code execution. The vulnerability has a CVSS score of 9.3.

items.title: Unauthenticated PHP Object Injection in Mirasvit Cache Warmer
items.summary: Sansec discovered a critical (CVSS 9.8) unauthenticated PHP object injection vulnerability in Mirasvit Cache Warmer, a popular Magento extension. A crafted cookie on any storefront page can lead to remote code execution.

items.title: Unrestricted File Upload in Magento and Adobe Commerce (PolyShell)
items.summary: A critical flaw in Magento's REST API allows unauthenticated attackers to upload executable files to any store using a polyglot technique to bypass validation. While a fix is in Magento 2.4.9, older supported versions remain vulnerable without backports.
